title: Parthian feudal houses rule Iran for over a thousand years

tellings.quote: >> So, get this. The Parthians rule Iran for 400 years directly.

plain: The Parthians were an ancient ruling people of Iran. A researcher named Jason Jorjani tells podcast host Jesse Michels that they ruled Iran directly for 400 years, and the story as told holds that their noble family houses kept power there for more than a thousand years in all. He offers it as a sign of how long hidden lines of power can last.
